records.title: TensorHub: Scalable and Elastic Weight Transfer for LLM RL Training
records.reason: Read the primary TensorHub design and scale experiments. It reduces stalls and transfer latency when synchronizing weights between LLM RL trainers and rollout workers, including a reported 1T-model transfer comparison; this is training/rollout orchestration rather than general inference serving, so relation to the target throughput lineage is indirect.

records.title: ReAttn: Improving Attention-based Re-ranking via Attention Re-weighting
records.reason: Read the primary ReAttn method, ranking experiments, and limitations. It is an attention-based LLM reranker intended as an efficient alternative to generation-based reranking and introduces post-hoc cross-document IDF and entropy weighting; however, its contribution is retrieval ranking quality, not optimization of model inference execution/serving, so scope fit is weak.

records.title: Hierarchical Text Classification with LLM-Refined Taxonomies
records.reason: The paper applies LLM-refined taxonomies to hierarchical text classification; its stated contribution is classification quality and taxonomy structure, not model inference cost or serving.

records.title: ABC-Bench: Benchmarking Agentic Backend Coding in Real-World Development
records.reason: Read the primary benchmark task and evaluation sections. ABC-Bench measures backend coding agents on repository-level tasks; it evaluates agent capability and does not introduce inference efficiency or serving improvements.

records.title: Debiasing Large Language Models via Adaptive Causal Prompting with Sketch-of-Thought
records.reason: Adaptive causal prompting targets debiasing and reasoning behavior; the primary abstract does not propose an inference efficiency, memory, latency, or serving technique.
